## About

Ritu Raj is a Full Stack Developer and AI & Machine Learning student.
He builds modern web applications using React, JavaScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Java and Python.
His interests include Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Data Structures & Algorithms and Software Engineering.
